conditions: Inputs are the scenario's job_description and resume_text, passed to the prompts directly. Production joins overlapping text chunks into resume_text (open item A6); that duplication is not reproduced.
PDF extraction and the resume-summary and credentials steps are not evaluated.
E2 is COUPLED to E1 as in production: it receives E1's cleaned output. E3 receives only the job description and the resume text and never E1 or E2 data.
Model settings are those written in the ChatGroq(...) call of src/parser.py. No seed is set, as in production, so repeats measure run-to-run variation rather than a fixed result.

The runner retries a transport failure at most once. The model client is created with max_retries=0 (an evaluation override; production leaves the library default), so the runner's retry is the ONLY retry and every HTTP request is one logged attempt.

The model client is created with a request timeout (evaluation_overrides.request_timeout, seconds). A request that exceeds it fails as a timeout, which the runner treats as a transport failure (one retry). Production sets no timeout, and the installed client library applies none by default.
The model name recorded is the CONFIGURED name, echoed back by the client library in the response metadata. It is not an identifier verified or reported independently by the provider.
Scenario files stay unfrozen (draft); their content hashes are recorded and the run refuses if any changed.

Repeat 1 comes from source run pipeline_8a8a6a446c17, which set no explicit client request timeout; repeats 2-3 of this run use request_timeout=120 s. The repeats therefore differ in this one client setting; no other setting, prompt, dataset file or scoring file differs.
limitations: Ten hand-authored synthetic scenarios, one model, draft-1 labels: a baseline, not a generalisation claim.
Pooled rates add numerators and denominators across scenarios; per-scenario results are kept beside them.
E3 numbers are deterministic screens, not verification that bullets are factually correct.
Ranges across repeats show variation between runs; they are not confidence intervals.
Repeats are split over two runs (pipeline_8a8a6a446c17: repeat 1; this run: repeats 2-3). 23 call-log line(s) of the interrupted source run are excluded.
The report scores only the supplied precomputed outputs. It is not a measurement of a live model.
Stage reports are embedded unchanged from score.py and e3.py; read their own limitations.
E3 results are deterministic screens, not verification that bullets are factually correct.
